in_marathi.name: Raghuraj
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे King of Ragas
in_marathi.long_meaning: Raghuraj हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Raghuraj is a name derived from Sanskrit, meaning 'King of Ragas'. Ragas are the musical notes and emotions expressed in Indian classical music. This name is believed to bring harmony and creativity, reflecting the deep connection between music and spirituality in Indian culture.

vedic_reference.note: The name Raghuraj is derived from the ancient Indian epic, the Ramayana, where Raghu is the name of a great king, the father of Lord Rama. The name Raghuraj means the 'ruler of the Raghu Dynasty'.
